name: Gas Pipeline Branch to Soligalich (Kostroma Oblast)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Gas Pipeline Branch to Soligalich, Soligalich Gas Pipeline Spur
values.StartLocation: Tie-in to Ukhta-Torzhok trunk strings 3 and 4 at km 848.65 (Mezhdurechensky district)
values.RouteNotes: No published route or GIS found; only endpoints (tie-in at km 848.65 of Ukhta-Torzhok strings 3/4, Mezhdurechensky district, Vologda Oblast, to the projected GRS in Soligalich). Not mapped.

researcher_notes: Not in roster: no row for a Soligalich/Kostroma branch; the Ukhta-Torzhok trunk rows (P5541-P5543 Vuktyl strings, P0767/P1439/P2707/P7537 Yamal strings) are the parent trunks, this is a separate 63.8 km DN300 spur (tie-in km 848.65 of strings 3 and 4; which roster rows those strings are is ambiguous). Add-threshold met: sponsor Gazprom (customer OOO Gazprom transgaz Ukhta, contractor AO Gazstroyproekt per neftegazpro); endpoints Vologda-border tie-in to Soligalich GRS; concrete step = under construction. Length 63.8 km sourced >=25 km. 63.8 km, DN300, 7.4 MPa, 30,000 m3/h initial GRS capacity, tie-in km 848.65: Glavgosekspertiza via Stroitelnaya Gazeta (project entered state expertise late 2022). 0.327 bcm/y average annual volume, Gazprom transgaz Ukhta as customer, completion planned end-2025 (undated 26 Feb post, 2026 or 2025): neftegazpro.ru (a construction-leads site, tertiary; value only). Status: Presidential Administration letters page dated 2 July 2026 reports Gazprom Group organisations are building 'Gazoprovod-otvod k gorodu Soligalich', Soligalich GRS-town interblock line and town street network (53% of street network laid); SMR completion with gas-supply readiness planned for 2026, so status = construction (end-2025 date has slipped; completion not confirmed). Independence: stroygaz (Glavgosekspertiza experts), kremlin.ru (Gazprom/governor report) and neftegazpro (contractor listing) are different publishers but all trace to Gazprom/project documentation; treat as medium. Owner stated as Gazprom PJSC [100%] following the convention of other Gazprom trunk rows; operating entity is Gazprom transgaz Ukhta (subsidiary; entity_lookup returned only 'Transgaz' (unrelated), no Gazprom transgaz Ukhta entity exists, none created). ProposalYear left blank (late-2022 expertise submission is not a proposal year). Capacity is annual average gas volume, not a design nameplate. Route: none found, no coordinates fabricated; candidate for route creation (endpoints and km 848.65 tie-in sourced). Note gas supply to Soligalich was earlier expected end-2022/early-2023 (ko44.ru, 3 Mar 2022), not cited.
